---
title: "Forward-estimate revisions"
subtitle: "How estimates for a given variable and out-year have moved across budget updates"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
tar_source("R")

revs <- tryCatch(tar_read(revisions), error = function(e) tibble::tibble())
```

::: {.callout-note}
Each point is one Budget Paper or MYEFO release; the x-axis is the
document's release date. Filter to a jurisdiction, variable, and
forecast fiscal year to see how the estimate has moved as each
Budget update has been released. **You must pick all three filters
to get a clean trail.**
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(revs) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("No revisions yet.")
} else {
  rev2 <- revs |>
    filter(!is.na(release_date)) |>
    arrange(jurisdiction, variable_id, fiscal_year, release_date)

  shared <- SharedData$new(rev2)

  bscols(
    widths = c(3, 9),
    list(
      filter_select("jur", "Jurisdiction",  shared, ~jurisdiction,
                    multiple = FALSE),
      filter_select("var", "Variable",      shared, ~canonical_label,
                    multiple = FALSE),
      filter_select("fy",  "Forecast year", shared, ~fiscal_year,
                    multiple = FALSE)
    ),
    plot_ly(shared,
            x = ~release_date, y = ~value_aud_mil,
            color = ~doc_type,
            colors = c(budget  = "#1f3a93",
                       myefo   = "#a6611a",
                       outcome = "#5a6c7d"),
            type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
            text = ~document_id,
            hovertemplate = paste(
              "<b>%{text}</b><br>",
              "Released: %{x}<br>",
              "%{y:,.0f} AUD mil<extra></extra>"
            )) |>
      plotly::layout(
        font   = list(family = "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif", size = 12L),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.18, title = list(text = "")),
        margin = list(l = 60L, r = 20L, t = 30L, b = 70L),
        xaxis  = list(title = "Document release date"),
        yaxis  = list(title = "AUD millions", tickformat = ",")
      )
  )
}
```

## All revisions

```{r}
if (nrow(revs) == 0L) {
  htmltools::p("Empty.")
} else {
  revs |>
    arrange(jurisdiction, variable_id, fiscal_year, release_date) |>
    transmute(
      Jurisdiction  = jurisdiction,
      Variable      = canonical_label,
      `Forecast FY` = fiscal_year,
      Released      = release_date,
      DocType       = doc_type,
      `Value (AUD mil)` = round(value_aud_mil),
      Source        = document_id
    ) |>
    reactable(
      defaultPageSize = 15,
      searchable      = TRUE,
      filterable      = TRUE,
      striped         = TRUE,
      columns = list(
        `Value (AUD mil)` = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = TRUE))
      )
    )
}
```
